name: Can you replace mobile home paneling with regular drywall?

mainEntity.name: Can you replace mobile home paneling with regular drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing older mobile home wall panels with standard taped and mudded drywall is a popular upgrade. However, you must account for framing capacity and wall thickness. Mobile home interior walls are often built using smaller 2x2 or 2x3 framing, meaning hanging heavy 5/8-inch drywall can add excessive weight. Finish contractors often use 1/4-inch or 3/8-inch lightweight drywall or reinforce framing members before hanging full-weight panels. Upgrading to regular drywall improves soundproofing, fire resistance, and home resale value, while also giving the interior the look of a traditional site-built house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Using lightweight drywall or reinforcing the existing studs allows you to replace dated vinyl panels with a smooth, seamless finish that looks like a traditional site-built home.
